mapper.select: select t.id as "tenantId", t.name, t.city, t.status, t.trial_start_at as "trialStartAt", t.trial_end_at as "trialEndAt", s.id as "storeId", s.address, s.contact_phone as "contactPhone", coalesce(sw.wechat_id, dsw.wechat_id) as "supportWechatId", coalesce(sw.display_text, dsw.display_text) as "supportText" from tenant t left join store s on s.tenant_id = t.id left join support_wechat sw on sw.tenant_id = t.id and sw.enabled left join support_wechat dsw on dsw.tenant_id is null and dsw.enabled where t.id = #{tenantId}

select exists(select 1 from store where tenant_id = #{tenantId}) as "storeReady", (select count(*)::integer from staff_account where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'active') as "staffCount", (select count(*)::integer from service_item where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'active') as "serviceCount", (select count(*)::integer from card_template where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'active') as "cardTemplateCount", (select count(*)::integer from resource where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and enabled) as "resourceCount", (select count(*)::integer from member where tenant_id = #{tenantId}) as "memberCount", (select count(*)::integer from bookable_slot where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'published' and start_at > current_timestamp) as "futureSlotCount", (select count(*)::integer from bookable_slot where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'published' and end_at > current_timestamp) as "operationalSlotCount", (select count(*)::integer from booking b join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id where b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (bs.start_at at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = current_date and b.status != 'cancelled') as "todayBookings", (select count(*)::integer from booking b join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id where b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (bs.start_at at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = current_date and b.status in ('reserved', 'arrived')) as "todayPendingFulfillment", (select count(*)::integer from booking b join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id where b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (bs.start_at at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = current_date and b.status in ('deducted', 'note_done')) as "todayCompletedFulfillment", (select count(*)::integer from bookable_slot where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'draft' and start_at > current_timestamp) as "scheduleDraftCount", (select id from bookable_slot where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'draft' and start_at > current_timestamp order by start_at limit 1) as "nextScheduleDraftId", (select (start_at at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date from bookable_slot where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'draft' and start_at > current_timestamp order by start_at limit 1) as "nextScheduleDraftDate", exists( select 1 from service_item si join staff_service_binding ssb on ssb.service_item_id = si.id and ssb.tenant_id = si.tenant_id join staff_account sa on sa.id = ssb.staff_account_id and sa.status = 'active' join service_resource_binding srb on srb.service_item_id = si.id and srb.tenant_id = si.tenant_id join resource r on r.id = srb.resource_id and r.enabled join card_template_service_scope ctss on ctss.service_item_id = si.id and ctss.tenant_id = si.tenant_id join card_template_staff_scope ctst on ctst.card_template_id = ctss.card_template_id and ctst.staff_account_id = sa.id and ctst.tenant_id = si.tenant_id join card_template ct on ct.id = ctss.card_template_id and ct.status = 'active' where si.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and si.status = 'active' ) as "scheduleReady", (select count(*)::integer from member_card mc join card_template ct on ct.id = mc.template_id cross join platform_config pc where mc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and pc.config_key = 'member_card.expiring_warn_days' and (mc.base_status = 'suspended' or mc.valid_until < current_date or (mc.card_type = 'count' and mc.remain_count = 0) or mc.valid_until <= current_date + cast(pc.value_text as integer) or (mc.card_type = 'count' and mc.remain_count <= ct.low_balance_threshold))) as "warningCount"

select d.store_profile_draft as "storeProfile", d.business_hours_draft as "businessHours", d.resources_draft as resources, d.completion_status as completion, d.status, oi.trial_notice_acknowledged_at is null as "trialNoticeRequired", greatest( 1, ceil(extract(epoch from (t.trial_end_at - t.trial_start_at)) / 86400.0)::integer ) as "trialDays" from store_onboarding_draft d join tenant t on t.id = d.tenant_id join owner_wechat_identity oi on oi.id = #{ownerIdentityId} and oi.tenant_id = d.tenant_id where d.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
select store_profile_draft, business_hours_draft, resources_draft, completion_status from store_onboarding_draft where tenant_id = #{tenantId} for update
select id, name from store where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by id

select s.id, s.name, s.city_code as "cityCode", city.name as city, s.district_code as "districtCode", district.name as district, s.detail_address as "detailAddress", s.address, s.contact_phone as "contactPhone", s.business_categories as "serviceScopes", s.business_hours as "businessHours" from store s join administrative_city city on city.code = s.city_code join administrative_district district on district.code = s.district_code where s.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
select code, name from administrative_city where enabled order by sort_order, code
select code, name from administrative_district where city_code = #{cityCode} and enabled order by sort_order, code

select city.code as "cityCode", city.name as city, district.code as "districtCode", district.name as district from administrative_city city join administrative_district district on district.city_code = city.code and district.code = #{districtCode} where city.code = #{cityCode} and city.enabled and district.enabled

insert into store( tenant_id, name, name_key, business_categories, city_code, district_code, detail_address, address, contact_phone, business_hours ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{nameKey}, cast(#{serviceScopes} as jsonb), #{cityCode}, #{districtCode}, #{detailAddress}, #{address}, #{contactPhone}, cast(#{businessHours} as jsonb) ) returning id
mapper.update: update store set name = #{name}, name_key = #{nameKey}, business_categories = cast(#{serviceScopes} as jsonb), city_code = #{cityCode}, district_code = #{districtCode}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, address = #{address}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId}

update store_onboarding_draft set store_profile_draft = cast(#{payload} as jsonb), completion_status = jsonb_set(completion_status, '{storeProfileDone}', 'true'::jsonb), updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'draft'

update store_onboarding_draft set business_hours_draft = cast(#{payload} as jsonb), completion_status = jsonb_set(completion_status, '{businessHoursDone}', 'true'::jsonb), updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'draft'

update store_onboarding_draft set resources_draft = cast(#{payload} as jsonb), completion_status = jsonb_set(completion_status, '{resourceDone}', 'true'::jsonb), updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'draft'
mapper.select: select id, name, resource_type as "resourceType", capacity, enabled, sort_order as "sortOrder" from resource where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by sort_order, id

insert into resource(tenant_id, store_id, name, resource_type, capacity, enabled, sort_order) values (#{tenantId}, #{storeId}, #{name}, #{resourceType}, #{capacity}, #{enabled}, #{sortOrder}) returning id
mapper.update: update resource set name = #{name}, resource_type = #{resourceType}, capacity = #{capacity}, enabled = #{enabled}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{resourceId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from resource where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id != #{resourceId} and enabled
select count(*) from service_resource_binding where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and resource_id = #{resourceId}
select count(*) from bookable_slot where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and resource_id = #{resourceId}
mapper.delete: delete from resource where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{resourceId}
mapper.select: select id, login_name as "loginName", staff_name as "staffName", role_label as "roleLabel", status, first_login as "firstLogin", exists( select 1 from staff_credential_secret secret where secret.tenant_id = staff_account.tenant_id and secret.staff_account_id = staff_account.id ) as "credentialAvailable" from staff_account where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by id

select account.id as "staffId", account.staff_name as "staffName", account.login_name as "loginName", secret.key_id as "keyId", secret.cipher_version as "cipherVersion", secret.nonce, secret.ciphertext from staff_account account join staff_credential_secret secret on secret.tenant_id = account.tenant_id and secret.staff_account_id = account.id where account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and account.id = #{staffId}
select distinct key_id from staff_credential_secret order by key_id

select distinct on (key_id) tenant_id as "tenantId", staff_account_id as "staffId", key_id as "keyId", cipher_version as "cipherVersion", nonce, ciphertext from staff_credential_secret order by key_id, staff_account_id

insert into staff_account(tenant_id, store_id, login_name, password_hash, staff_name, role_label) values (#{tenantId}, #{storeId}, #{loginName}, #{passwordHash}, #{staffName}, #{roleLabel}) returning id
mapper.insert: insert into staff_profile(tenant_id, staff_account_id, display_name) values (#{tenantId}, #{staffId}, #{displayName})
mapper.update: update staff_account set login_name = #{loginName}, staff_name = #{staffName}, role_label = #{roleLabel}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{staffId}
mapper.insert: insert into staff_credential_secret( tenant_id, staff_account_id, key_id, cipher_version, nonce, ciphertext ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{staffId}, #{keyId}, #{cipherVersion}, #{nonce}, #{ciphertext} ) on conflict (staff_account_id) do update set key_id = excluded.key_id, cipher_version = excluded.cipher_version, nonce = excluded.nonce, ciphertext = excluded.ciphertext, updated_at = current_timestamp where staff_credential_secret.tenant_id = excluded.tenant_id
mapper.update: update auth_session set revoked_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and actor_type = 'staff' and subject_id = cast(#{staffId} as varchar) and revoked_at is null
mapper.select: select count(*) from card_template_staff_scope where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and staff_account_id = #{staffId}
select count(*) from staff_service_binding where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and staff_account_id = #{staffId}
select count(*) from bookable_slot where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and staff_account_id = #{staffId}
mapper.delete: delete from staff_account where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{staffId}
mapper.select: select id, name, service_type as "serviceType", duration_min as "durationMin", default_capacity as "defaultCapacity", deduct_count as "deductCount", status from service_item where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into service_resource_binding(tenant_id, service_item_id, resource_id) values (#{tenantId}, #{serviceId}, #{resourceId})
insert into staff_service_binding(tenant_id, staff_account_id, service_item_id) values (#{tenantId}, #{staffId}, #{serviceId})
mapper.update: update service_item set name = #{name}, service_type = #{serviceType}, duration_min = #{durationMin}, default_capacity = #{capacity}, deduct_count = #{deductCount}, status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{serviceId}
update service_item set status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{serviceId}
mapper.select: select id, name, status from service_item where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{serviceId} for update
mapper.delete: delete from service_item where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{serviceId}
delete from service_resource_binding where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and service_item_id = #{serviceId}
delete from staff_service_binding where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and service_item_id = #{serviceId}
mapper.select: select id, name, card_type as "cardType", sale_price_yuan as "salePriceYuan", total_count as "totalCount", valid_days as "validDays", low_balance_threshold as "lowBalanceThreshold", status from card_template where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by id
select count(*) from card_template where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{templateId}
select id, name, status from card_template where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{templateId} for update
select count(*) from member_card where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.insert: insert into card_template_service_scope(tenant_id, card_template_id, service_item_id) values (#{tenantId}, #{cardTemplateId}, #{serviceId})
insert into card_template_staff_scope(tenant_id, card_template_id, staff_account_id) values (#{tenantId}, #{cardTemplateId}, #{staffId})
mapper.update: update card_template set name = #{name}, card_type = #{cardType}, sale_price_yuan = #{salePrice}, total_count = #{totalCount}, valid_days = #{validDays}, low_balance_threshold = #{lowBalanceThreshold}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{templateId}
update card_template set status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{templateId}
mapper.delete: delete from card_template where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{templateId}
delete from card_template_service_scope where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and card_template_id = #{templateId}
delete from card_template_staff_scope where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and card_template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.select: select id, name, member_no as "memberNo", contact_text as "contactText", bind_status as "bindStatus" from member where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by id desc
insert into member(tenant_id, store_id, name, contact_text) values (#{tenantId}, #{storeId}, #{name}, #{contactText}) returning id, member_no as "memberNo"
select id, card_type as "cardType", total_count as "totalCount", valid_days as "validDays" from card_template where id = #{templateId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'active'
select cast(value_text as integer) from platform_config where config_key = #{configKey} and enabled
mapper.update: update member_invite_code set status = 'revoked', updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and status = 'active'
mapper.select: select bs.id, bs.start_at as "startAt", bs.end_at as "endAt", bs.capacity, bs.reserved_count as "reservedCount", bs.status, si.name as "serviceName", sa.staff_name as "staffName", r.name as "resourceName", bs.service_item_id as "serviceId", bs.staff_account_id as "staffId", bs.resource_id as "resourceId" from bookable_slot bs join service_item si on si.id = bs.service_item_id join staff_account sa on sa.id = bs.staff_account_id join resource r on r.id = bs.resource_id where bs.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (bs.start_at at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = #{scheduleDate} order by bs.start_at
select id, name, duration_min as "durationMin", default_capacity as "defaultCapacity", deduct_count as "deductCount" from service_item where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'active' order by id
select id, business_hours as "businessHours" from store where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by id limit 1

select sa.id, sa.staff_name as "staffName", sa.role_label as "roleLabel", not exists( select 1 from bookable_slot bs where bs.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and bs.staff_account_id = sa.id and bs.status = 'published' and #{startAt} is not null and tstzrange(bs.start_at, bs.end_at, '[)') && tstzrange(#{startAt}, #{endAt}, '[)') ) as available from staff_account sa join staff_service_binding ssb on ssb.staff_account_id = sa.id and ssb.tenant_id = sa.tenant_id where sa.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and sa.status = 'active' and ssb.service_item_id = #{serviceId} order by sa.id

select r.id, r.name, r.resource_type as "resourceType", r.capacity, not exists( select 1 from bookable_slot bs where bs.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and bs.resource_id = r.id and bs.status = 'published' and #{startAt} is not null and tstzrange(bs.start_at, bs.end_at, '[)') && tstzrange(#{startAt}, #{endAt}, '[)') ) as available from resource r join service_resource_binding srb on srb.resource_id = r.id and srb.tenant_id = r.tenant_id where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.enabled and srb.service_item_id = #{serviceId} order by r.sort_order, r.id

select si.id as "serviceId", si.store_id as "storeId", si.name as "serviceName", si.duration_min as "durationMin", si.default_capacity as "defaultCapacity", sa.id as "staffId", sa.staff_name as "staffName", r.id as "resourceId", r.name as "resourceName", r.capacity as "resourceCapacity", s.business_hours as "businessHours", exists(select 1 from staff_service_binding ssb where ssb.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ssb.service_item_id = #{serviceId} and ssb.staff_account_id = #{staffId}) as "staffBound", exists(select 1 from service_resource_binding srb where srb.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and srb.service_item_id = #{serviceId} and srb.resource_id = #{resourceId}) as "resourceBound" from service_item si join store s on s.id = si.store_id and s.tenant_id = si.tenant_id join staff_account sa on sa.id = #{staffId} and sa.tenant_id = si.tenant_id and sa.status = 'active' join resource r on r.id = #{resourceId} and r.tenant_id = si.tenant_id and r.enabled where si.id = #{serviceId} and si.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and si.status = 'active'

select count(*) from bookable_slot where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and staff_account_id = #{staffId} and status = 'published' and tstzrange(start_at, end_at, '[)') && tstzrange(#{startAt}, #{endAt}, '[)')

select count(*) from bookable_slot where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and resource_id = #{resourceId} and status = 'published' and tstzrange(start_at, end_at, '[)') && tstzrange(#{startAt}, #{endAt}, '[)')

select count(distinct ct.id) from card_template ct join card_template_service_scope ctss on ctss.card_template_id = ct.id and ctss.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id join card_template_staff_scope ctst on ctst.card_template_id = ct.id and ctst.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id where ct.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ct.status = 'active' and ctss.service_item_id = #{serviceId} and ctst.staff_account_id = #{staffId}

select id, store_id as "storeId", name, duration_min as "durationMin", default_capacity as "defaultCapacity", deduct_count as "deductCount" from service_item where id = #{serviceId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'active'
select count(*) from staff_account where id = #{staffId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'active'
select count(*) from resource where id = #{resourceId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and enabled
select id, status from bookable_slot where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{slotId} and status = 'draft' for update
mapper.update: update bookable_slot set service_item_id = #{serviceId}, staff_account_id = #{staffId}, resource_id = #{resourceId}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, capacity = #{capacity}, status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{slotId} and status = 'draft' and reserved_count = 0
mapper.select: select (select coalesce(sum(sale_amount_yuan), 0) from offline_sale_record where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and sale_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date) as "monthlySalesYuan", (select count(*)::integer from booking where tenant_id = #{tenantId}) as bookings, (select count(*)::integer from attendance_confirm where tenant_id = #{tenantId}) as attendances, (select count(*)::integer from deduction_record where tenant_id = #{tenantId}) as deductions, (select count(*)::integer from member_card mc join card_template ct on ct.id = mc.template_id cross join platform_config pc where mc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and pc.config_key = 'member_card.expiring_warn_days' and (mc.base_status = 'suspended' or mc.valid_until < current_date or (mc.card_type = 'count' and mc.remain_count = 0) or mc.valid_until <= current_date + cast(pc.value_text as integer) or (mc.card_type = 'count' and mc.remain_count <= ct.low_balance_threshold))) as "warningCount"

select mc.id, m.name as "memberName", ct.name as "cardName", mc.remain_count as "remainCount", mc.valid_until as "validUntil", case when mc.base_status = 'suspended' then 'suspended' when mc.valid_until < current_date then 'expired' when mc.card_type = 'count' and mc.remain_count = 0 then 'empty' when mc.valid_until <= current_date + cast(pc.value_text as integer) then 'expiring' when mc.card_type = 'count' and mc.remain_count <= ct.low_balance_threshold then 'low_balance' else 'active' end as status from member_card mc join member m on m.id = mc.member_id join card_template ct on ct.id = mc.template_id cross join platform_config pc where mc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and pc.config_key = 'member_card.expiring_warn_days' order by mc.valid_until, mc.remain_count nulls last

select os.id, m.name as "memberName", ct.name as "cardName", os.sale_amount_yuan as "saleAmountYuan", os.sale_date as "saleDate", os.pay_method_label as "payMethodLabel" from offline_sale_record os join member m on m.id = os.member_id join member_card mc on mc.id = os.member_card_id join card_template ct on ct.id = mc.template_id where os.tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by os.sale_date desc, os.id desc

select b.id, m.name as "memberName", si.name as "serviceName", bs.start_at as "startAt", b.status, exists(select 1 from attendance_confirm ac where ac.booking_id = b.id) as "attended" from booking b join member m on m.id = b.member_id join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id join service_item si on si.id = bs.service_item_id where b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by bs.start_at desc, b.id desc

select dr.id, m.name as "memberName", si.name as "serviceName", dr.deduct_count as "deductCount", dr.before_count as "beforeCount", dr.after_count as "afterCount", dr.deducted_at as "createdAt", 'deducted' as status from deduction_record dr join member m on m.id = dr.member_id join booking b on b.id = dr.booking_id join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id join service_item si on si.id = bs.service_item_id where dr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by dr.deducted_at desc
select count(*) from resource where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id}
select count(*) from staff_account where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id}
select count(*) from service_item where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id}
